decisions.reason: A fifteen-day express delivery program is a low-cost service built on existing production and has stayed on the website consistently, so it supports competitiveness in the door and gate business.

The seventy-two-hour express program sets the firm apart in a weak construction market and has remained listed, though fast delivery is costly to sustain and could be merged into other express offers.
The express program for doors and gates has had its own page in both years, which signals strategic importance as a service differentiator.
The online ordering and digital services platform is core infrastructure for dealer and customer relationships, and digitalization investments are rarely reversed.
The fire and smoke protection door moved up to its own page in 2024 and serves a regulation-driven, stable demand segment.
